$comment: Project permissions for agents working in this repo, so ordinary read-only
Be clear about what this does and does not do. It widens Bash only. It does
NOT restrain the Write tool — a room agent running with acceptEdits can
create or overwrite any file it can reach, while still being unable to run
`ls -R`. That asymmetry is real and backwards from a security standpoint;
the deny list below is the part that actually narrows reach, and the
mpa.agentPermissions setting is what decides whether commands run at all.
Also note a headless room agent cannot answer an approval prompt: anything
needing one strands rather than being denied.
